payload.description_html: Figure 2. Noteosuchus colletti from the Induan of South Africa. N. colletti (A-E,G) compared with selected bones of Mesosuchus browni (F, H) from the early Anisian of South Africa. Lower block (A), upper right block (B), and upper left block (C,D), close-up of right second sacral rib in either dorsal or ventral view (E), and close-up of left ilium in lateral view (G) of N. colletti (AM 3591, holotype); and second sacral vertebra and ribs in dorsal view (SAM-PK-6046) (F) and left ilium in lateral view (SAM-PK-7416) (H) of M. browni. Abbreviations: ac, acetabulum; alp, anterolateral process; cv, caudal vertebrae; dr, dorsal ribs; dv, dorsal vertebrae; fl, forelimb; hl hindlimb; il, ilium; poap, postacetabular process; prap, preacetabular process; pg, pelvic girdle; plp, posterolateral process; sv, sacral vertebrae. Scale bars equal 5 cm in (A-D) and 5 mm in (E-H).
